notes.title: Playtest 7 - The only good bug is a dead bug!
notes.content:
As always, thank you for playtesting Bounce Castle. All of the updates and bug fixes here are to address issues found by you guys, the testers. You're a vital part of this project and I'm very grateful that you've given your time to help make this game better!

[h1]General Updates:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Enhanced Enemy Threat Indicator visuals
[*] Improved control over prediction object creation
[*] Better Threat and Portal Blocking detection after Rollback
[*] Many new Sound Effects!
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Token Death is now checked for after every enemy attack, not just those that cause movement.
[*] Many instances of text overflowing it's text area have been addressed.
[*] Loading a saved game into a boss chamber no longer soft locks
[*] Dead Character Tokens no longer respawn upon rollback (unless they were alive in the state being returned to)
[*] Ethereal Abilities do not persist after rollback if they were not present in the pre-rollback state
[*] Slam abilities trigger a Movement Phase, preventing actions from being taken until movement ends
[*] Enemy Character Sheet and Prop Sheets are hidden when a player ends their turn.
[*] Increased Spike Ball prediction scale to match real scale
[*] Fire Spirits targeting position is saved across reloads and rollbacks
[*] Many props and enemies that were missing descriptions and images have had them applied
[*] Spike Balls respect the Rollback
[*] Updated Pawn description to describe it's Shield
[*] Castle Elite chamber has Kill Elite bonus objective
[*] Spike Ball damage is preventer by Armored buff
[*] The Spike Wall in the elite chamber now deals damage
[/list]

notes.title: New Region: Castle! A bunch of other stuff too!
notes.content:
[h1]New Region: Castle[/h1]
You can now play through the newest region, the Castle! With new enemies including the Fire Spirit, Pawn and Tower! A bunch of new traps and play things can be found in the castle's chambers so give them a whirl and see if you can break anything!

[h1]Character Facing Art Updated[/h1]
Characters now face right at the camera and have new art to show them facing all 4 directions. Right now it just looks cool, but later it'll be useful for doing special attacks to a character's back or sides!

[h1]New VFX[/h1]
VFX added for a bunch of elements that were missing them, can you spot them? 

[h1]Play, Test, Feedback![/h1]
Keep in mind this is an ongoing playtest and we really need your feedback! Join our discord and tell us all your thoughts!
Did anything go wrong, break, freeze, get stuck, was reeeeally annoying? Tell us! Take screen shots too if you can!
What did you like best? What do you want more of?
Got any ideas? We'd love to hear them!

notes.title: Turn Based Carnival Update!
notes.content:
So much to test! Go testers, unleash your bug seeking abilities and break this game!!

[h1]Major Changes/Additions:[/h1]
[h2]Knight Mini-boss[/h2]
The Knight is clomping around the final Forest stage. Can you prevent him from destroying all your crystals?!

[h2]Merchant[/h2]
Buy some new abilities on your way to the Knight! You'll see the merchant after Forest - 2.

[h2]Ability Pickups[/h2]
A new type of pickup is available, Ability Pickups. This will give you an Ethereal ability which means it can be used once in the stage it is picked up in. It won't come with you to the next stage so use it or lose it!

[h2]Prediction Line Optimizations[/h2]
The prediction line has had many optimizations made to it that should improve its performance. Also you can now see the direction any objects will move that you collide with, use it to make those ricochets work in your favor!

[h2]New Flow Crystal Visual[/h2]
Hey who are this sleepy little guys holding up the crystals?! Aww they are so cute! I feel compelled to protect them even more!

[h2]Some Character Voices[/h2]
The Archer, Wizard and Goblin Archer have voice lines (well, vocal sounds at least). Give them a listen!

Lots of other stuff too. Try it out and let me know any and all feedback, bug encounters and feels!

notes.title: Refine and Refactor! Bounce Castle Patch Notes - May 23
notes.content:
Lots of changes in this update but many of them are under the hood, so to speak. Many core systems got a refactor, meaning that things should be more stable overall but since much of the core code has been changed we'll need extensive testing to find any new bugs!

A couple major features have been added:

[h1]Leveling Up![/h1]
What would a fantasy style game be without levels? Characters can now gain XP from a variety of combat activities, well mainly just killing enemies and blocking spawns right now. Gain enough XP and your characters will Level Up, rewarding them with a Perk Point. Perk Points can then be spent at the end of a chamber to Upgrade your existing skills.
Only the starter skills have upgrade options right now, but more ability upgrades are coming soon as well as more ways to gain XP.

[h1]Enemy Spawn Logic[/h1]
Previous playtests had a static 3 enemy spawn points created each round but know, there is some logic behind the number of spawns you'll see round to round! This was done in an effort to smooth out the challenge of each chamber.

[h2]New nice stuff:[/h2]
Title screen animation, music and intro
Loading screen
Victory screen animations, sounds
Reduce final tutorial level difficulty
Forest chamber 2 redesign 

[h2]Refactored Systems:[/h2]
Chamber Objectives refactored
Combat Round flow refactored

[h2]Many bug fixes[/h2]

Please let us know via our Discord if you encounter any bugs, screen shots are ideal and a description of how the bug came to be in as much detail as you can. Thank you so much for helping to test Bounce Castle, your feedback and enthusiasm really fuels the fire!
